shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat upright slab
register-like horizontal division of the surface
a repeated row of small motifs along an upper band
justification: Both are upright slabs carved in low relief with content divided into horizontal zones and containing profile creatures, but the specific subjects differ almost entirely: A shows schematic quadrupeds, a large beaked bird, a small crouching human-like figure and rows of abstract signs, while B shows a large elaborately robed standing human figure with raised arm facing a second figure, with dense text-like signs above and vegetal/floral filling. The relationships (animal above animal on a pillar-like stone vs. two confronted anthropomorphic figures in a narrative scene) and the level of naturalism in the human figures are quite different.
